FilNam <- list.files(path = paste(here(), RawDat, "ELISA/", sep = "/"), pattern = "\\.xlsx$")

# Read in data from excel file
DatELISA <- read_all(paste(paste(here(), RawDat, "ELISA", sep = "/"), FilNam, sep = "/"))

```{r elisa-data-normalization, include = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
# Data normalization by averaging technical repeats and subtracting blank averages per plate
DatNorm <- lapply(DatELISA, function(qq){
  
  if (any(qq[["Sample"]] == "Standard_Curve")) { # With standard curve available
    
    # Change factor level order for IgE
    qq[["Sample"]] <- factor(qq[["Sample"]], 
                             levels = c("Naïve", 
                                        "Week1", 
                                        "Week2", 
                                        "Week3", 
                                        "Week4", 
                                        "Week10",
                                        "Positive_Ctrl",
                                        "Standard_Curve",
                                        "Blank"))
    
    # Handle data normalization by plate
    sapply(levels(qq[["Plate"]]), function(rr) {
      
      DatNorm <- qq[qq[["Plate"]] %like% rr,] %>%
        # select technical replica columns and get the row means
        mutate(., "Avg_OD" = .[, colnames(.) %like% "Duplicate"] %>%
                 rowMeans(.)) %>%
        # subtract the averaged negative water control "blank" from all other values from the same plate
        mutate(., "delta_OD" = .[,"Avg_OD"] - .[.$Sample %in% "Blank",] %>%
                          .[, colnames(.) %like% "Duplicate"] %>%
                          unlist(.) %>%
                          mean(.)) %>%
        # remove the blanks form the table
        .[!.$Sample %in% "Blank",]
      
      
      # Extract the standard curve information
      StdCrv <- DatNorm[DatNorm[["Sample"]] %in% "Standard_Curve",] %>%
        # convert the factor format into numbers in two steps
        mutate(., across("Guinea_pig", as.character)) %>%
        mutate(., across("Guinea_pig", as.numeric)) 
      
      
      # Interpolation of missing antibody concentrations against the standard curve
      DatOut <- DatNorm[!DatNorm[["Sample"]] %in% "Standard_Curve",] %>%
        mutate(., "Concentration" = approx(x = StdCrv[["delta_OD"]],
                                           y = StdCrv[["Guinea_pig"]],
                                           xout = .[["delta_OD"]])[["y"]])
      
    }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      bind_rows(.) %>%
      droplevels(.)
    
  } else { # Without standard curve available
    
    # Change factor level order for IgG
    qq[["Sample"]] <- factor(qq[["Sample"]], 
                             levels = c("Naïve", 
                                        "Week1", 
                                        "Week2", 
                                        "Week3", 
                                        "Week4", 
                                        "Week10", 
                                        "Blank"))
      
    # Extract and normalize data
    sapply(levels(qq[["Plate"]]), function(rr) {
      
      qq[qq[["Plate"]] %like% rr,] %>%
        # select technical replica columns and get the row means
        mutate(., "Avg_OD" = .[, colnames(.) %like% "Duplicate"] %>%
                 rowMeans(.)) %>%
        # subtract the averaged negative water control "blank" from all other values from the same plate
        mutate(., "delta_OD" = .[,"Avg_OD"] - .[.$Sample %in% "Blank",] %>%
                          .[, colnames(.) %like% "Duplicate"] %>%
                          unlist(.) %>%
                          mean(.)) %>%
        # remove the blanks form the table
        .[!.$Sample %in% "Blank",]
      
    }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      bind_rows(.)
    
  }
})
```

```{r save-elisa-data, include = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
# Save the data for all scratch bouts to the head
# Directory to were data is saved
BibPath1 <- paste(here(), 
                  "Data", 
                  "ELISA", 
                  sep = "/")

# Create subdirectory to save excel files
dir.create(BibPath1, 
           showWarnings = FALSE)  

# Create workbook to store data
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook() 

# Vector of sheet names
SheetNames <- names(DatNorm)

# Implementation of sheets into workbook
sapply(SheetNames, function(x) { addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = x) }, simplify = FALSE)

  # writing the data into the respective workbook sheet  
mapply(function(qq, rr) {  
  
  writeData(wb, 
            sheet = rr, 
            x = qq, 
            startRow = 1, 
            startCol = 1, 
            rowNames = TRUE)
}, qq = DatNorm, 
   rr = SheetNames,
   SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

  # Saving the workbook
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, 
                         file = paste(BibPath1, 
                                      "IgG and IgE titer.xlsx", 
                                      sep = "/"), 
                         overwrite = TRUE)

gc()
```

```{r elisa-data-analysis, include = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
# Data analysis
ResELISA <- lapply(DatNorm, function(qq) {
  
  # Rename outcome variable to be consistent for model
  if (any(colnames(qq) == "Concentration")) {
    
    Dat <- DatNorm$IgE %>%
      rename("outcome" = "Concentration")
    
  } else {
    
    Dat <- qq %>%
      rename("outcome" = "delta_OD")
    
  }
  
  # Summary Statistics of dependent variable: Event_Length
  SumStat <- Dat %>%
    select(Sample, outcome) %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    get_summary_stats(., type = "full")
  
  # Run a linear regression model on the data as it showed lowest AIC
  Mod <- lm(outcome ~ Sample,
          data = Dat)
  
    SelMod <- "Linear Regression Model"
  
  # Get model summary
  SumMod <- summary(Mod)
    
  # Get adjusted R2 for the model to assess fit
  AdjR2 <- SumMod[["adj.r.squared"]]
  
  # Check of model predictor is relevant
  AovMod <- anova(Mod)
  
  # Pairwise comparison
  posthoc <- emmeans(Mod,
                     pairwise ~ Sample,
                     adjust = "sidak")
    
    # Lette code for pairwise comparison
    PhLetter <- cld(posthoc,
                    alpha = 0.05,
                    Letters = letters,
                    adjust = "sidak")
    
    ResPH <- "Estimated marginal means"
  
  # COLLATE DATA--------------------------------------------------------------
   
  # Collate the test outcome calls
    AssTest <- as.data.frame(rbind("Selected model"      = SelMod,
                                   "Pairwise comparison" = ResPH)) %>%
      setNames(., "Outcome")
      
    # Compile output data list
    AovDat <- list("Test selection"      = AssTest,
                   "Data summary"        = SumStat,
                   "Model"               = Mod,
                   "Model summary"       = SumMod,
                   "Adjused R2"          = AdjR2,
                   "Model validity"      = AovMod,
                   "Pairwise comparison" = posthoc,
                   "Pairwise by letter"  = PhLetter)
})
```
